LCDC Exported Functions

group LCDC_Exported_Functions

Functions

void LCDC_LCD_SET_RST(bool reset)

Enable or disable LCD reset signal, which is active low.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_LCD_SET_RST(true);
    platform_delay_ms(120);
    LCDC_LCD_SET_RST(false);
}

参数:

reset -- [in] New state of LCD reset signal. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • true: Enable LCD reset signal.

  • false: Disable LCD reset signal.

void LCDC_Cmd(FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable LCDC.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_Cmd(ENABLE);
}

参数:

NewState -- [in] New state of LCDC. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • ENABLE: Enable LCDC.

  • DISABLE: Disable LCDC.

void LCDC_SwitchIF(LCDC_IF_T InterFace)

Selecting the output interface of LCDC.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_SwitchIF(LCDC_IF_DBIC);
}

参数:

InterFace -- [in] The output interface of LCDC. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • LCDC_IF_eDPI: eDPI interface.

  • LCDC_IF_DBIB: DBIB interface.

  • LCDC_IF_DBIC: DBIC/SPIC interface.

  • LCDC_IF_DPI: DPI interface.

void LCDC_SwitchMode(LCDC_MODE_T Mode)

Switch LCDC to required mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_SwitchMode(LCDC_AUTO_MODE);
}

参数:

mode -- [in] LCDC work mode. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • LCDC_AUTO_MODE: Auto mode.

  • LCDC_MANUAL_MODE: Manual mode.

void LCDC_SwitchDirect(uint32_t Dir)

Swtich LCDC function to write or read.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_SwitchDirect(LCDC_TX_MODE);
}

参数:

dir -- [in] The transmission mode of LCDC. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • LCDC_TX_MODE: Write pixel data from FIFO to pannel.

  • LCDC_RX_MODE: Read back data from pannel.

void LCDC_DmaCmd(FunctionalState NewState)

Start or stop DMA.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_DmaCmd(ENABLE);
}

参数:

NewState -- [in] New state of LCDC DMA. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • ENABLE: Enable DMA handshake and internal FIFO control.

  • DISABLE: Disable DMA handshake and internal FIFO control.

void LCDC_TeCmd(FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the function of automatically writing data when the valid edge of the tear signal arrives.

void driver_lcdc_init(void)

    LCDC_TeCmd(ENABLE);
}

参数:

NewState -- [in] Enable or disable the function of automatically writing data when the valid edge of the tear signal arrives. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • ENABLE: Enable the function of automatically writing data when the valid edge of the tear signal arrives.

  • DISABLE: Disable the function of automatically writing data when the valid edge of the tear signal arrives.

参数:

NewState -- [in] Enable or disable the function of automatically turning on DMA when the valid edge of the tear signal arrives. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • DISABLE: Disable the function of automatically turning on DMA when the valid edge of the tear signal arrives.

void LCDC_ClearINTPendingBit(uint32_t LCDC_CLEAR_INT)

Clear pending bit of specified interrupt.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_ClearINTPendingBit(LCDC_CLR_TX_AUTO_DONE);
}

参数:

LCDC_CLEAR_INT -- [in] Specified interrupt type. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • LCDC_CLR_TX_FIFO_THESHOLD: When FIFO offset smaller than threshold.

  • LCDC_CLR_TX_FIFO_OVERFLOW: TX FIFO overflow.

  • LCDC_CLR_TX_FIFO_EMPTY: TX FIFO is empty.

  • LCDC_CLR_TX_AUTO_DONE: Auto transmit done.

  • LCDC_CLR_RX_FIFO_OVERFLOW: RX FIFO overflow, only in DBIB interface.

  • LCDC_CLR_RX_AUTO_DONE: Auto receive done, only in DBIB interface.

  • LCDC_CLR_TEAR_TRIGGER: Tear signal trigger.

  • LCDC_CLR_WAVEFORM_FINISH: Waveform finish.

void LCDC_StructInit(LCDC_InitTypeDef *LCDC_InitStruct)

Initialize LCDC structure with default values.

Example: 

// Declare and initialize LCDC configuration structure
LCDC_InitTypeDef LCDC_InitStruct;
LCDC_StructInit(&LCDC_InitStruct);

// Modify default configuration as needed
LCDC_InitStruct.LCDC_Interface = LCDC_IF_DBIC;        // Use DBIC interface
LCDC_InitStruct.LCDC_PixelInputFarmat = LCDC_INPUT_RGB565;  // Set input format to RGB565
LCDC_InitStruct.LCDC_DmaThreshold = 16;              // Modify DMA threshold

// Initialize LCDC with modified configuration
LCDC_Init(&LCDC_InitStruct);

备注

Default values are shown in the table below:

Parameter Name

Default Value

Description

LCDC_Interface

LCDC_IF_DPI

Interface type set to DPI

LCDC_RamlessEn

DISABLE

Ramless function disabled

LCDC_GroupSel

1

Pin Group 1 selected

LCDC_PixelInputFarmat

LCDC_INPUT_RGB888

Input format set to RGB888

LCDC_PixelOutpuFarmat

LCDC_OUTPUT_RGB888

Output format set to RGB888

LCDC_PixelBitSwap

LCDC_SWAP_BYPASS

No bit swapping

LCDC_TeEn

DISABLE

Tear Effect function disabled

LCDC_TePolarity

LCDC_TE_EDGE_RISING

Tear signal rising edge trigger

LCDC_TeInputMux

LCDC_TE_LCD_INPUT

Tear signal from LCD panel

LCDC_DmaThreshold

8

DMA threshold set to 8

LCDC_InfiniteModeEn

DISABLE

Infinite mode disabled

LCDC_PhaseShift

LCDC_SPI_PHASE_SHIFT_0_DEGREE

No SPI clock phase shift

LCDC_DelayCell

0

No delay cells

参数:

LCDC_InitStruct -- : Pointer to LCDC_InitTypeDef structure

void LCDC_Init(LCDC_InitTypeDef *LCDC_InitStructure)

Initializes LCDC according to the specified parameters in the LCDC_Init.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_InitTypeDef lcdc_init = {0};
    lcdc_init.LCDC_Interface = LCDC_IF_DBIC;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_PixelInputFarmat = LCDC_INPUT_RGB565;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_PixelOutpuFarmat = LCDC_OUTPUT_RGB565;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_PixelBitSwap = LCDC_SWAP_BYPASS;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_GroupSel = 1;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_DmaThreshold = 112;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_TeEn = ENABLE;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_TePolarity = LCDC_TE_EDGE_FALLING;
    lcdc_init.LCDC_TeInputMux = LCDC_TE_LCD_INPUT;
    LCDC_Init(&lcdc_init);
}

参数:

LCDC_InitStructure -- [in] Pointer to a LCDC_InitTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for LCDC.

void LCDC_DMA_LinkList_Init(LCDC_DMALLI_InitTypeDef *LCDC_DMA_LLIConfig, LCDC_DMA_InitTypeDef *LCDC_DMA_Init)

Configure linklist of LCDC DMA.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    LCDC_DMA_InitTypeDef LCDC_DMA_InitStruct = {0};
    LCDC_DMA_StructInit(&LCDC_DMA_InitStruct);
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_ChannelNum = 0;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_DIR  = LCDC_DMA_DIR_PeripheralToMemory;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_SourceInc           = LCDC_DMA_SourceInc_Inc;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_DestinationInc      = LCDC_DMA_DestinationInc_Fix;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_SourceDataSize      = LCDC_DMA_DataSize_Word;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_DestinationDataSize = LCDC_DMA_DataSize_Word;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_SourceMsize         = LCDC_DMA_Msize_16;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_DestinationMsize    = LCDC_DMA_Msize_16;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_SourceAddr          = 0;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_Multi_Block_Mode   = LLI_TRANSFER;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_Multi_Block_En     = ENABLE;
    LCDC_DMA_InitStruct.LCDC_DMA_Multi_Block_Struct = LCDC_DMA_LINKLIST_REG_BASE + 0x50;
    LCDC_DMA_Init(LCDC_DMA_CHANNEL_INDEX, &LCDC_DMA_InitStruct);
    LCDC_SET_GROUP1_BLOCKSIZE(ST77903_WIDTH * PIXEL_BYTES);
    LCDC_SET_GROUP2_BLOCKSIZE(ST77903_WIDTH * PIXEL_BYTES);
    LCDC_DMALLI_InitTypeDef LCDC_DMA_LLI_Init = {0};
    LCDC_DMA_LLI_Init.g1_source_addr = (uint32_t)buf;
    LCDC_DMA_LLI_Init.g2_source_addr = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)buf + ST77903_WIDTH * PIXEL_BYTES);
    LCDC_DMA_LLI_Init.g1_sar_offset = ST77903_WIDTH * PIXEL_BYTES * 2;
    LCDC_DMA_LLI_Init.g2_sar_offset = ST77903_WIDTH * PIXEL_BYTES * 2;
    LCDC_SET_INFINITE_ADDR((uint32_t)buf, (uint32_t)buf + ST77903_WIDTH * PIXEL_BYTES);
    LCDC_DMA_LinkList_Init(&LCDC_DMA_LLI_Init, &LCDC_DMA_InitStruct);
}

参数:

  • LCDC_DMA_LLIConfig -- [in] linklist initialization structure.

  • LCDC_DMA_Init -- [in] LCDC DMA initialization structure.
